key_findings: SLS-induced irritant contact dermatitis in mouse cheek produced spontaneous wiping (pain) but not scratching, and mechanical and heat hyperalgesia on day 1.
Bradykinin alone increased wiping over saline in SLS mice, while pruritogens enhanced scratching.
